set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
#==============================================================================
project(__LIBRARY_NAME__ C CXX)
#==============================================================================
# Compile and link settings shared with the WebAssembly engine.
include("__WASM_SIDE_MODULE_CONFIG__")
#==============================================================================
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "__OUTPUT_DIRECTORY__")
__CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE__
__C_FLAGS__
__CXX_FLAGS__
__DEFINES__
set(module_library_name __LIBRARY_NAME__)
#==============================================================================
include_directories(
${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
PRIVATE
__INCLUDES__
${NELSON_WASM_SIDE_MODULE_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
#==============================================================================
FILE(
GLOB
MODULE_SRC
__C_CPP_FILES__
)

	${module_library_name}
	SHARED
	${MODULE_SRC}
)
#==============================================================================
# The gateway symbols are resolved against the engine when the module is
# loaded with dlopen; nothing is linked here.

target_link_options(${module_library_name} PRIVATE ${NELSON_WASM_SIDE_MODULE_LINK_OPTIONS})
set_target_properties(${module_library_name} PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX ".so")
